changes: More outer margins, card padding and grid gaps.
Anonymous resource links and ideas go into a separate private Suggestions queue.
Owner can review, archive, restore or create a private resource draft.
No visitor publishing, private draft access or file uploads.

checks.result: 23 unit tests; production build; bundle privacy gate; 55 API assertions; cloud missing-object regression gate.

tested: Anonymous idea without a link receives confirmation.
Owner sees the suggestion and creates a private draft with prefilled name and description.
Suggestion moves from Pending to Reviewed after saving.
320px Spanish form submit button reachable; no horizontal overflow.
390px directory has 63 cards and images, 24px outer margins, no horizontal overflow, and observed scrollY greater than 12000.

review.result: Owner-only reads and moderation; same-origin public POST; bounded body, honeypot and persistent shared hourly quota; injected status ignored; conditional writes reject stale moderation. No open finding >=4.

caveats: Public submissions are limited to 50 per hour across the directory. No email or identity collected.
Clerk was tested as a saved private resource; Clerk authentication SDK was not integrated.
Original sandbox build stayed idle and was stopped (exit 130); approved unsandboxed final build passed.

calibration.claim: Visitors need a public submission path while owner moderation stays private
Separate suggestions preserve draft privacy and require owner review before publishing
Mobile folder scrollbar comes from the navigation rule; hide it while preserving snapped horizontal movement
